summary: Frontend regression on the new AI Piece quality + Review Modal features. Verified: (1) admin login OK; (2) /gerar generates clean, publishable copy via GPT-5.4 Mini with NO literal labels ('TÍTULO:', 'LEGENDA:', 'LEGENDA/CORPO:', 'CTA:'); first line becomes the preview title; (3) 'Salvar peça' persists the piece and navigates to /pecas with the new item on top; (4) clicking piece-open-<id> opens piece-review-dialog showing full review-content; (5) 'Editar' reveals review-edit-title/review-edit-content, editing + 'Salvar alterações' persists (PUT /api/pieces/{id}) and updates modal header/list; (6) 'Publicar' from modal triggers 'Peça publicada!' toast and status badge becomes 'Publicada'. Image generation was triggered (generator-image-toggle + generate-image-button); the request was in-flight but did not complete within a 95s wait window in this preview - reported as PARTIAL per instructions (image is expected to take ~40-60s and can occasionally exceed 90s).

Review modal (piece-review-dialog) is complete: read + edit + approve/publish/schedule actions integrated with backend and reflect back in the list.
